page.overview:
Who is Galeas Morgan?

Officer Galeas Morgan is a character created by Fantasy Flight Games for their Arkham Horror Fiction series of Cthulhu Mythos stories. He made his first appearance in the 2017 novella Hour of the Huntress by Dave Gross.

A junior officer in the Arkham Police Department, Morgan is a tall fellow but almost painfully thin, to the point where Jenny Barnes, on their first meeting, guessed that he skipped meals. Although prone to a certain social awkwardness, he has shown himself to be a brave and resourceful individual. (: Hour of the Huntress)

Morgan appears to be in a developing relationship with tomboy mechanic Lonnie Ritter, Lonnie seemingly possessing deep feelings for the officer, feelings which may not be entirely reciprocated. (: Hour of the Huntress)

Morgan assisted globetrotting dilettante Jenny Barnes in her quest to find her missing sister Izzie in the town of Arkham. Along with Lonnie Ritter and Miskatonic University anthropology professor Tilde Félix, Morgan fought a cult dedicated to the Outer God Shub-Niggurath, facing down and banishing the Dark Young which they had summoned during a sacrificial ritual. (: Hour of the Huntress)
